verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships official developer docs for building TypeScript plugins, including a tutorial that compiles a sample plugin from source and loads it into the app (obsidian-docs-15, -16, -26, -33). It also publishes a public API definition repo documenting interfaces such as Vault (obsidian-gh-1). Community reports of third-party plugins like Dataview and a CRDT collaboration plugin confirm developers build against this API. missing for 10: evidence of API reference depth beyond the Vault interface snippet, and hands-on developer accounts of the SDK/docs experience itself.
